chart.alt: Two charts. Bar chart: percentage of adults who slept less than six hours a night, 2004 and 2024. Aged 16–24: 12% and 27%. Aged 25–39: 15% and 24%. Aged 40–59: 18% and 21%. Aged 60 and over: 20% and 19%. Pie chart: main reasons for poor sleep in 2024 — phones or screens in bed 31%, work or study stress 26%, noise 14%, caring for children 12%, health problems 10%, other 7%.

document.title: Sleeping less than six hours
document.question:
The chart below shows the percentage of adults in four age groups who slept less than six hours a night in one country in 2004 and 2024. The pie chart shows the main reasons for poor sleep given in 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
